No published gprMax airborne example models antenna attitude/swing - identified as a literature gap (our inference)
verdict: published record consistent with our simulation: low-frequency UAV-GPR either flies ~1 m AGL for coupling (INGV 20-140 MHz) or relies on migration imaging rather than raw B-scans (Wang 2026, 5-20 m AGL same band); our 48.8 dB dynamic-range penalty at 15 m is physics, not a model defect; solver-side airborne modelling is officially validated (Smith finite-height dipole, RMS <= 0.271%)
